Name: Climates of Ferngill
Author: Koihime Nakamura
TagLine: [DEPRECATED, NOT NEEDED] This mod expands the climate system to be more robust, adding custom weathers. This climate system can be tweaked to add a degree of difficulty to the game.
Description:
**As of the upcoming* 1.6, this mod is officially dead. For a good reason: you can set weather patterns in Content Patcher now, rather than needing a full**
**blown C# mod.**

**Thank you, to everyone who downloaded this mod and enjoyed it.** * I can't really speak as to when 1.6 will be out, but I do know the upcoming SMAPI and CP improvements make this irrelevant.Climates of Ferngill

**What's New**
- Variable Rain.
- Fog and Blizzards

**Multiplayer**
Supports MP, with most features locked out to main player

**Requirements**

- SMAPI 3.8+
- Stardew Valley 1.5+

**Overview**

This mod is in a beta state due to needing to rebuild it, but here's what's working now

Note: Some features from the original mod are not yet recreated!

**Install Instructions**
Install into your Mods/ folder. **Make sure any folder labeled ClimatesOfFerngill/ is uninstalled.**

**Acknowledgements**
See https://github.com/Sakorona/SDVMods/tree/develop/ClimatesOfFerngill#acknowledgements (Hadi deserves all of the credit for the fog textures!)

If I have left you out of acknowledgements, please contact me so I can get you added to the acknowledgement list
